text:
amy_s: Hey team — enterprise prospect (FinTech) asked for concrete evidence around logging/monitoring and audit trail controls. Main asks: 1) SIEM-compatible log formats and delivery options, 2) retention defaults and long-term export (>=1 year), 3) admin activity / privileged ops audit detail, 4) proof of tamper-resistance / immutability for audit logs. Can someone drop the short answers we can send to their vendor-risk team?

ravi_se: quick summary: we provide structured request logs, auth events, admin actions, and system-level telemetry. Formats: JSON (newline-delimited), CEF, and syslog (RFC5424) for real-time streaming. Delivery: pushing to customer-managed S3, direct syslog over TLS, or webhook push.

jordan_soln: +1 on formats. For SIEM ingestion we recommend JSON NDJSON or CEF. Example event keys: timestamp, tenant_id, user_id, actor_role, action, resource, request_id, src_ip, user_agent, outcome.

amy_s: retention questions — prospect insists on >=365 days. What do we commit?

nina_pm: Hosted plan default retention is 90 days for request logs and 30 days for low-level debug traces. For enterprise Dedicated/Private we can configure retention up to 3 years; for hosted we offer configurable long-term export to customer S3 (manual or scheduled) so they can keep raw logs for as long as needed.

ravi_se: important: for hosted customers we can set up scheduled daily or weekly exports to S3 (gzip + encryption). We can also enable incremental exports so you don't pull full history every time.

amy_s: do we provide evidence for immutability / tamper-resistance?

ravi_se: we provide the following evidentiary items: a) chain-of-custody export logs showing export job runs (timestamps + checksums), b) logs stored to customer-controlled S3 with server-side encryption + optional client-side encryption (if requested), c) built-in append-only write pattern for audit indices in our backend; we can provide config screenshots and S3 object versioning examples for the PoC.

jordan_soln: for admin activity: we emit explicit admin.activity events for every admin API call and Console action. Sample entry: 
``` 
{
  "timestamp": "2024-11-12T21:14:07Z",
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "actor": "alice_admin",
  "actor_role": "admin",
  "action": "role.update",
  "target": "team-eng",
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "ip": "203.0.113.7"
}
```
These events include pre/post state for role/config changes where applicable.

amy_s: nice. The vendor wants SIEM-ready sample logs and a short attestation doc. Can we produce a 1-page summary + two sample NDJSON files for ingestion?

nina_pm: yes — we can produce a 1-page control statement (retention, delivery, encryption, access controls) plus sanitized sample NDJSON (no PII) and an export job log for a 7-day window. I'll coordinate with ops.

infra-bot: Deploy job triggered: export-samples/1749987654 started by nina_pm at 1749987600

ravi_se: note on redaction: tokens and secrets are redacted at ingestion. We still log request metadata (request_id, path, response_code) but not secret values. That should satisfy data-leak policies.

amy_s: price question: prospect may ask about incremental cost for daily S3 export + retention >90 days. Any quick figure?

jordan_soln: cost depends on egress + storage. Ballpark: hosted export job + S3 storage billed as exported-data GB (usage). For committed Dedicated we can include export to customer S3 as part of contract (negligible additional infra cost, mostly egress). I can ask finance for a quote.

amy_s: if they want live SIEM ingestion (syslog) — any special ports/proxies or certs?

ravi_se: syslog over TLS on custom endpoint; prospect must allow outbound TLS to our syslog IPs or set up peered VPN for Dedicated. Client certs supported for mutual TLS.

amy_s: action items?

nina_pm: I'll assemble: 1) one-page control statement (PDF) 2) two sample NDJSON files (auth+admin) 3) export job log (CSV) 4) short runbook for SIEM ingestion (syslog/CEF/S3) — target ETA: EOD tomorrow.

jordan_soln: I'll ping finance for an export-retention estimate and attach a sample S3 lifecycle policy snippet.

amy_s: perfect — I'll reply to the prospect with roadmap + request to accept NDA for the sanitized samples. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ravi_se: FYI to security reviewers: if they request signed attestation, we escalate to legal & compliance for a SOC-type letter.

amy_s: noted. will keep you posted.

(threads ends)
